book.name: 2 Ubitru
book.title: Ubvur uwu uvaa Ubitru aka atsɛng

content: Ubvurmum uwu uvaa uwi, uba ru umbi aze awɛrhamum. Ra abvur ha ikivarhake umum itsɛng iyituwa umbi abinkɛ umbi aka ikaifɛrhkɔ idzidzɛrhe.
Umum ibee umbi ayitu irhɛm asarkasar abika asɔm Arherhu-Num abi isha aka arherhe ra arherhu Uteijee Uwuku Ufufɔrh aka atsuka ra angwĩ abi itser Uyesu.
Undzumu ubinkpi umum iki ibee iyituwa umbi ĩgɛ ri imimasha upfung anera abika ayɛɛi idzidzɛrhe awuri idzeka, awuri idɔsi ikponi iyiki ibewambɔ.
Umbɔ awuri igɔr agɛ, <<Ibiba ha iwuri iwu ukang, Uyesu aka abemuwa? Uko rimɔ̃ɔ̃ atokamɛn aka akpembɔ, bɔr abina awu ru nyaka ake aka awe asi ifaruke udzur ri inggbaashia umbɔ aka amunu upfung.>>
Bɔr umbɔ adzum ayiruwe ugɛ isha rimɔ̃ɔ̃ awu ri irhɛm Unum aka akũ amuna afã nu abĩ ake adzek ra amɛ̃ na adziirte ake nggu amɛ̃.
Mɔcɛ akũ amɛ̃ akɛrɛ ha ikɛi adɛke na atsĩme upfung hã nggu nggaa inai.
Awe ri irhɛm hã afã nu abĩkɛ umɛn iki inyã icɛrɛ aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ idzɛu urha, ru unum ukpuku utsu uvau umbɔ aka itsĩme abika asheri iwei Unum.
Bɔr ubina unying àka niba ayirukumbi, aze awɛrhamum, nggu Uteijee unuma unying uwe ru nyaki imɛka unaku ugɔnga, nu imɛka unaku ugɔnga iwe ru nyaku unuma unying.
Uteijee asi idɔ̃rhũnga ri itsuifɛr ubinkpi unga aka abemuwe, ru nyaka abɔɔ aka akaifɛrhkɔ. Unga adɔngamɛn nggu umbi, asi ibeenga unera atsim, bɔr ubɛn unera adzipa.
Bɔr unum ukpu Uteijee uwuri iba ru nyaku uvɛu. Afã awuri igwirke ru nggaa ubvun, abin afã nggu abĩ awuri ikpikpĩĩ atsim, nu abĩ nu ubɛn ubin uku uwe ru ake awuri igwigwir.
Ngge iki iwe ugɛ ubɛn abinkɛ aka adziira umɛn awuri itsĩme riminɛ, imɛ̃ngge umbi anera awu agusembi? Imɛ̃ngge umbi asei asasar ri ibibɛk iwei Unum.
Umbi àka isei na afosi ibiba unum ukpu Unum na abee ukpɔ uba ifetem. Unum hã afã awuri ikpĩĩ ru urha, na abin afã nu abĩ awuri ititɛ̃ɛ̃ ri imani urha.
Bɔr ri idɔsi ibibemuwenga, umɛn ifosa afã aka afa nu abĩ aka afa, anangkɛ irhirhika iki iwe umɔ.
Nggee, aze awɛrhamum, àka adzɛu akɛrɛ ha, àka atsu asumbi na asei iseimbi ra asu Unum iyiki isheru uvau, àka adɔɔr nggu unga.
Àka ayita ra amɛnmbi ugɛ idɔngamɛn Uteijee ri ibiba ugɛ ra anera akpo ififɔrh. Ru nyaku uze ungwɛ̃mɛn Uburhu aka atsɛnga umbi ri itsoiyɛ Unum aka adzowe unga.

Atsɛng ikpũ arherhe unying ra abvurnga kishoo. Abvurnga hã awe ra abina akɔɔ aka aghong ihwihwɛng, abika asheri ihwihwɛng ashimbɔ ri imangmang iyiki iker, umbɔ iki idzipuwe agbenke ru nyaka umbɔ aki idzipuwe abvur Arherhu-Num akɔɔ, rimi hã ikowe umbɔ itsitsim.

Nggee, aze awɛrhamum, ngge iki iwe ugɛ umbi aka ahwɛngmbi akɛrɛ ha, àka angwɛ̃dzɛn nggu ikpũ anerabɛ aka abɔrukumbɔ idɔsu Unum, utsur imesambɔ iyi igbɛrangwĩ idarhngge amɛnmbi, itsu umbi agbambi igba ri ididɛ̃ɛ̃mbi.
Bɔr àka aseng ri imimutu nu ihwihwɛng Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo uwuku ufɔrh umɛn. Ikpikpoi iwu iyi unga icɛrɛ nu ugbagbaa. Iwerimi.
